exposure: standardised electronic booking for Induction of labour (IoL)
cohort: The study included women and birthing people who gave birth between January 1, 2023, and July 31, 2024, at two tertiary maternity hospitals.
finding: The implementation of an IoL MDT and electronic booking service led to a consistent fall in early term IoL rates and improved utilisation of resources.
mod_finding: Unplanned caesarean section rates were higher for IoL (32%) compared to spontaneous labour (25%).
gest_age: Early term IoL was defined as 37+0 to 38+6 weeks.
